notes.title: Hotfix 5
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue where players who fell more than once in the same map would get stuck midair.
-Added a new prompt reminding players to equip blessings.

notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.notes: Fixed an issue selecting body magic.

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.notes:
• Lowered Scorpion damage 2->1
	• Fixed an issue that caused the item info popup to stay on the screen (for real this time!)
        • Fixed an issue which prevented fall damage from always killing a player

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.notes: Another fix for the item info popup. This hotfix fixes an issue that caused the popup to stick on the screen if you closed the menu while hovering over it.

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
This patch fixes an issue with the new item hover information popup staying on the screen after using the item.

I apologize for this oversight.

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
• Tentative fix for bug causing inv window to stay open indefinitely. 
	• Players can no longer move while a menu is open.
	• Tentative fix for players getting stuck after falling off cliff.
	• Added new starting blessing
	• Fixed spelling error in EULA
	• Added popup text when hovering over item.
	• Added bonus score multipliers to maps
        • Cleaned up some UI

notes.title: Blessings of No-more Released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Blessings of No-more is now available for purchase. BONM started as a pet project prototyping RPG combat, but turned into so much more! BONM has been a blast for me to work on and I plan to continue doing so. Shortly following this initial release of BONM I plan to release a free 1.1 patch which will include tons of new content and bug fixes for any issues that players might have encountered. I am the sole person on the development team for this game, so while I currently don't know of any major bugs there is always a chance that one slipped through, if you catch one please report it to me on the BONM Discord https://discord.gg/Z6UrhJd243 .

Thanks again to everyone who checks this game out!
